1.reason: Single fact (X0 of silicon) answered with general answering discipline in this session; no computation.

2.reason: Method plus feasibility conclusion from reasoning and literature; expected precision is stated as an attributed expectation, so it stays T1 and no computational run is forced.

3.reason: Code fix whose evidence is a diff and a test-execution receipt from the project's existing tests/; bounded local interactive work.

4.reason: Performance table on a simulated sample, internal, delivered without any statement about it -> T2-numeric with the limitation 'supports only performance in simulation'; 'internal look' does not lower it further; bounded local run.

5.reason: Claim that holds for data, compared against a threshold (within 1% of unity) and reported externally in a paper -> T3-C (highest of several applicable rules); done interactively/locally; if it outgrows a session it continues as M1 segments with a resumption summary, never a lowered tier.

6.reason: Number computed on simulation plus an assessment ('looks flat' = trend/comparison) with no confirmation asked -> T3-E, all numbers marked exploratory, unconfirmed; bounded local run.

7.reason: Deliverables are the skim and per-sample event counts on simulated samples with no statement about them -> T2-numeric (highest of the deliverables); ~3 days locally exceeds a session -> M2 resumable, admissible only via the control-layer helper with its qualified G5 record (rules not through S0), otherwise run as M1 segments with a resumption summary; local cost alone does not make it M3.

8.reason: Remote Slurm submission with no one present -> M3, whose executor guarantees G1-G5 are not available: follow the existing campaign rules and manual boundary, each submission user-approved, never claim M3. Output histograms from reprocessed raw (data) files for internal use, not wanted as a claim for data -> T3-E (would be T2-numeric only if the inputs were simulation; unclear -> higher).
